summary: TRACK 27.11 SEMANTICS CORRECTION VERIFICATION · VERDICT: PASS. All 58 regression tests passed (12 production-certification + 7 manifest-freshness + 8 deployment-gate + 11 deployment-certification + 5 integrity-scheduler-closeout + 3 backup-observability + 3 health-full + 8 backup-health-aggregator + 1 bundle-hygiene). Production certification state machine correctly implements: VERIFIED (fresh completed/ok), FAILED (completed/failed), NOT_YET_EXERCISED (no qualifying execution), STALE (outside freshness window), BLOCKED (documented blocker). Separate platform_band and release_band outputs present with release_counters.

verified_semantics.VERIFIED: Most recent qualifying completed event has status=ok and evidence is current (within 2-day freshness window)
verified_semantics.FAILED: Most recent qualifying completed event has status=failed (affirmative completed failure only)
verified_semantics.NOT_YET_EXERCISED: No qualifying execution exists (informational, not a defect)
verified_semantics.BLOCKED: Execution began or was required but could not complete because of a documented blocker
verified_semantics.STALE: Qualifying evidence exists but is outside the freshness window

platform_band.amber: any BLOCKED or STALE workflow (no FAILED)
platform_band.green: all VERIFIED (no FAILED, BLOCKED, or STALE)

release_band.review: any STALE workflow (no FAILED or BLOCKED)

critical_code_review_comments: production_certification.py correctly implements the 5-status state machine with truthful semantics
FAILED is only assigned when latest completed event has status=failed (line 278-280)
NOT_YET_EXERCISED is assigned when no completed event exists AND no blocker detected (line 232-234)
BLOCKED is assigned when blocker_reason detected from latest_any event (lines 229-231, 263-265)
STALE is assigned when latest completed/ok is outside FRESHNESS_WINDOW (2 days) (lines 268-270)
VERIFIED is assigned when latest completed/ok is fresh (lines 271-273)
platform_band and release_band are separate outputs with distinct rules
release_counters is a copy of counters for release-scoped reporting
